title: Figure 13: Influence of Lightcraft range and pointing angles on captured power
description: Graph of laser power captured by the Lightcraft (MW, 0-6) against slant range from laser (100-500 km) for "Radiated Laser Power = 10 MW", comparing 1.62 micron and 11.2 micron laser wavelengths. Annotations mark beam angles from 50° to 83° from the vertical, "End of Laser Airbreathing Propulsion", "Lightcraft Capture Dia. of 30 cm" and "Lightcraft Achievement of Orbital Speed" (2.9 MW and .04 MW endpoints). Caption: "Figure 13. Influence of Lightcraft Range and Pointing Angles on Captured Power [26]."
